mines.mine_notes: Underground block-cave mine (B3 cave + C-Zone cave), Kamloops, British Columbia. Produces copper-gold concentrate (treatment/refining charges on concentrate sales per company releases). FY2025 KPIs: 12,176 tpd milled, gold grade milled 0.52 g/t at 86% recovery, copper grade milled 0.57% at 89% recovery; gold sold 62,693 oz, copper sold 48.2 Mlbs. C-Zone cave construction on track for completion early-2026. In 2025 the company bought back the remaining 19.9% New Afton free-cash-flow interest (Ontario Teachers'). FY2025 per-ounce costs not disclosed (no annual report issued; production release only). Consolidated FY2024 AISC was $1,239/oz (by-product basis).

Open pit + underground gold mine, northwestern Ontario. FY2025 KPIs: 25,294 tpd milled, gold grade milled 1.05 g/t at 93% recovery; gold sold 287,434 oz; open-pit strip ratio 2.06 (waste:ore); underground lateral development 8,662 m. Underground ramping toward ~5,800 tpd in 2027. FY2025 per-ounce costs not disclosed (no annual report issued). FY2024 fallback from Q4 2024 results release: operating expenses $1,205/oz, cash costs $1,141/oz, AISC $1,524/oz (all by-product basis). Company recorded a $501.4M asset impairment reversal at Rainy River in 2025 tied to the Coeur arrangement agreement.

notes: No FY2025 annual report, 40-F, AIF or MD&A was issued: Coeur Mining completed its acquisition of all New Gold shares on 2026-03-20 (0.4959 Coeur shares per New Gold share); NGD was delisted from NYSE American (2026-03-20) and TSX (2026-03-23); New Gold applied to cease being a reporting issuer in Canada and to deregister under the US Exchange Act. Most recent SEC filing 2026-03-30. FY2025 operating data below is from the 2026-01-15 Q4/FY2025 production news release; FY2025 consolidated financials (revenue $1,476.1M, net earnings $857.9M, op. cash flow $898M) from the 6-K filed 2026-03-20 per StockTitan summary. Reserve/resource figures are Dec 31, 2024 (FY2024 40-F/AIF) — no 2025 year-end reserve update was published. Cerro San Pedro (Mexico) is in reclamation and excluded.
